_description: Index of popular package name snapshots used as the 'real packages' reference set for slopsquatting / HallucinatedPackageImport detection. The actual package lists live in the sibling data files to avoid duplication. This file provides metadata and ecosystem coverage notes.
_rationale: Slopsquatting detection works by comparing an import name against a known-real-packages set. A name that looks plausible but does NOT appear in the real set is a candidate hallucination. The snapshots here cover the two most hallucination-prone ecosystems (npm and PyPI) plus summary counts for others.

npm.description: Top npm packages by download popularity (popularity-sorted registry search + curated well-known packages)

pypi.description: Top PyPI packages by 30-day downloads (hugovk/top-pypi-packages ClickHouse dataset)

_detection_algorithm.step1: Normalize the import/require string to its registry package name (e.g. strip __init__ paths, handle @scope/pkg)
_detection_algorithm.step2: Look up normalized name in the ecosystem's real-packages set (npm-snapshot.json or pypi-snapshot.json)
_detection_algorithm.step3: If NOT found: compute Levenshtein distance to nearest real package name
_detection_algorithm.step4: If distance <= 2 AND real candidate exists: flag as likely TYPO hallucination
_detection_algorithm.step5: If distance > 2 OR no close real candidate: flag as likely FABRICATED or SUFFIX_PRO hallucination
_detection_algorithm.step6: Cross-check against hallucinated-corpus.json for confirmed hallucinations with elevated severity

_coverage_notes.npm_top_10250: Covers packages with >=~1000 weekly downloads. An LLM-hallucinated package that would actually have appeared in the top 10k would almost certainly be a real package. Packages below this threshold are not covered — false negatives possible for niche packages.
_coverage_notes.pypi_top_15000: Covers packages with >=~500 monthly downloads based on ClickHouse/PyPI stats. Same caveat applies for niche packages.
_coverage_notes.other_ecosystems: Cargo, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems etc. are NOT covered by snapshot files. For those ecosystems, rely solely on hallucinated-corpus.json entries or live registry lookup via depscope.dev API.
